releaseNotes:
<!--LANG:en-->
NOVA Studio 2.3.0

✨ What's new
- [Design] A new NOVA look: new colours, fonts, icon and a slimmer side rail.
- [Home] The app now opens on a Home screen with your balance, recent work and quick starts. Signed-out users get a Sign in button there.
- [Create] One Create page for images, video, speech and file analysis.
- [Video] New video studio: start from text, an image (first and last frame) or reference images; extend, edit, upscale and talking-avatar modes; live cost estimate; jobs keep running in the background, with a library and a frame-by-frame viewer.
- [Speech] Text to speech with every NOVA voice, and transcription of files or microphone recordings.
- [Analyze] Pull typed fields and yes/no decisions out of documents, with ready-made templates.
- [Settings] Your NOVA account and balance at the top of Settings.

🔧 Improvements
- [Account] Signing out of NOVA now returns to the welcome screen. Signing back in reopens the app with all your settings and models as you left them.
- [Account] NOVA switches itself on as soon as you sign in; no extra toggle needed.
- [Agents] The built-in NOVA Helper agent now has a model, so it answers right away, including in WeChat and other channels.
- [Agents] Agent replies, gateway docs, diagnostics and exports say NOVA Studio throughout.
- [Providers] NOVA shows its own name and icon in model pickers and settings.
- [Help] Feedback and Contact support open the NOVA website.
- [Settings] Device connections are hidden while that feature is being finished.
<!--LANG:zh-CN-->
NOVA Studio 2.3.0

✨ 更新内容
- [设计] 全新 NOVA 外观：新配色、字体、图标和更窄的侧边栏。
- [首页] 启动后进入首页，显示余额、最近内容和快捷入口；未登录时首页提供"登录"按钮。
- [创作] 图片、视频、语音和文件分析合并到同一个"创作"页面。
- [视频] 全新视频工作室：可从文字、图片（首帧/尾帧）或参考图开始；支持续写、编辑、超分和数字人口播；实时显示预计费用；任务在后台运行，附带作品库和逐帧查看器。
- [语音] 支持所有 NOVA 音色的文字转语音，以及文件或麦克风录音转文字。
- [分析] 从文档中提取结构化字段和是/否判断，附带现成模板。
- [设置] 设置页顶部显示 NOVA 账户与余额。

🔧 改进
- [账户] 退出 NOVA 登录后回到欢迎页；重新登录即恢复原来的全部设置和模型，无需重新配置。
- [账户] 登录后 NOVA 自动启用，无需再手动打开。
- [智能体] 内置的 NOVA 小助手已预设模型，开箱即可回复，微信等渠道同样可用。
- [智能体] 智能体回复、网关文档、诊断与导出内容统一显示 NOVA Studio。
- [服务商] 模型选择和设置中显示 NOVA 自己的名称和图标。
- [帮助] "反馈"和"联系支持"改为打开 NOVA 官网。
- [设置] 设备互联功能完善前暂时隐藏。
<!--LANG:END-->

<!--LANG:en-->
NOVA Studio 2.2.3

✨ What's new
- [Models] Image, embedding, speech, transcription, video and rerank models from cdkai.cc now appear alongside chat models.
- [Voice] New NOVA cloud dictation and read-aloud options in voice settings.
- [Account] Settings → Profile shows your NOVA account, balance and top-up instead of the old subscription panel.
- [Account] The balance matches the website and no longer disappears when your website sign-in expires.
- [Branding] Windows and the tray icon now say NOVA Studio.
<!--LANG:zh-CN-->
NOVA Studio 2.2.3

✨ 更新内容
- [模型] cdkai.cc 上的图像、向量、语音合成、语音识别、视频和重排序模型现已与对话模型一起列出。
- [语音] 语音设置新增 NOVA 云端听写与朗读。
- [账户] 设置 → 个人信息 显示你的 NOVA 账户、余额与充值入口，不再显示旧的订阅面板。
- [账户] 余额与官网一致，网站登录过期后也不会消失。
- [品牌] 窗口标题与托盘图标改为 NOVA Studio。
<!--LANG:END-->

<!--LANG:en-->
NOVA Studio 2.2.2 - First release

✨ What's included
- [Account] Sign in with your cdkai.cc account on the NOVA provider page. NOVA Studio creates an API key for this computer automatically, shows your balance and opens the top-up page.
- [Models] Every model on cdkai.cc in one place, with DeepSeek V4 Flash ready as the default for chat, translation and the quick assistant.
- [Privacy] No usage analytics, crash reporting or announcements are sent anywhere. Your sign-in is kept in your system keychain.
- [Source] NOVA Studio is based on Cherry Studio and released under the AGPL-3.0 license. See Settings → About for the source code.
<!--LANG:zh-CN-->
NOVA Studio 2.2.2 - 首个版本

✨ 包含内容
- [账户] 在 NOVA 服务商页面使用 cdkai.cc 账户登录。NOVA Studio 会自动为这台电脑创建 API Key，显示余额并可直接打开充值页面。
- [模型] cdkai.cc 上的全部模型集中在一处，默认使用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 进行对话、翻译和快捷助手。
- [隐私] 不发送任何使用统计、崩溃报告或公告请求。登录信息保存在系统钥匙串中。
- [源代码] NOVA Studio 基于 Cherry Studio，以 AGPL-3.0 许可证发布。源代码见 设置 → 关于。
<!--LANG:END-->
